triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var piece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!piece) return false; if (!ctx.piece || ctx.piece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId) return false; var shield = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'calm-shield'; }); if (!shield || !shield.intensity || shield.intensity <= 0) return false; return !!(ctx.damage && ctx.damage > 0); }
triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var piece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!piece) return { success: false }; var shield = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'calm-shield'; }); if (!shield || !shield.intensity || shield.intensity <= 0) return { success: false }; var absorbed = Math.min(shield.intensity, ctx.damage || 0); if (absorbed <= 0) return { success: false }; shield.intensity -= absorbed; ctx.damage = (ctx.damage || 0) - absorbed; var msg = piece.name + '的平静护盾格挡了' + absorbed + '点伤害'; if (shield.intensity <= 0) { removeStatusEffectById(piece.instanceId, shield.id); msg += '，护盾破碎'; } else { msg += '，剩余护盾' + shield.intensity + '点'; } return { success: true, message: msg }; }
